question: Can the species sequence of a spontaneously formed S0/S1 four-cycle (2 S0, 2 S1) carry selectable dynamical information, rather than simply share the same four materials and closed topology?
interpretation: This is a causal species-label permutation experiment, not proof of genetic heredity. We preserve all original per-particle energies and physical properties except the categorical S0/S1 labels, which control mobility once a ring edge breaks. Ring geometry and valence remain identical.

natural_sample.configuration: Original M6 unfed chemistry on 24x24 periodic grid, zero initial bonds, two density regimes, see campaigns/m6_4_cycles/protocol.json
natural_sample.selection: In each new world select the FIRST TWO DISTINCT material-ID 4-rings containing exactly 2 S0 and 2 S1; search in first-seen tick then sorted material ID order. No replacement if none appear.

fork.canonical_order: Start at lowest source particle ID, choose its lowest-ID cycle neighbor, traverse full original four-cycle deterministically.
fork.assignment: For each arm, choose among rotations and inversions of its specified species sequence the placement with minimum Hamming distance to the NATURAL original labels in the canonical cycle order, ties broken lexicographically. This includes unmodified native placement on the matching-isomer arm. Preserve exactly 2 S0 and 2 S1 globally.
fork.locked_equalities: Identical four particle IDs, positions, initial total energy and all per-particle energies, original four bonds and stored energy, all background particle states, RNG state and draws; only two ring material species labels differ across arms.
fork.physics: No simulator code/physical law changes. S0/S1 have identical max_bonds=2 and all S0–S0/S0–S1/S1–S1 bonds allowed with common 5% formation/0.2% break. Their free-particle mobility differs; all degree-two particles have zero movement.
fork.prebreak_prediction: Until the FIRST native original 4-ring edge BondEvent(kind=break), the ENTIRE state except ring labels is exactly identical in the two arms, including all coordinates, material energies, bonds, RNG fingerprint/draws and event counters, because the ring is fully valence saturated and immobile. First break step must coincide. If not, abort and report a violated mechanistic assumption.
fork.postbreak_prediction: After the first original ring edge rupture, identity-dependent movement can cause differences. Any effect is sequence/placement sensitivity, not heritable selection.

measurement.primary: Among selected paired forks in which an original ring edge breaks by followup tick180, compare by density (a) exact four-original-ID ring at tick180 and (b) exactly isolated connected four-ID quartet at tick180 for adjacent vs alternating label sequence.
secondary: First original ring edge break tick by arm, require exact match across paired arms
Number of followup ticks BEFORE first break with fully identical complete physical state after masking the S0/S1 ring labels
Fraction of POST-first-break observed ticks for which each fork again forms an exact ring of the original four IDs
Original 2S0+2S1 ring isomer type and whether each candidate arm was originally the native configuration
All four source material energies, original and permuted signatures C2:, first-loss tick, first source break event and matched RNG
Full-state hashes, source bond event trace and all right-censored/no-break cases per seed
measurement.definition_ring: Original four IDs make an isolated four-cycle of exactly four bonds and every ring particle has degree2; use existing M6.5 status().

preregistered_decision.positive: If either primary endpoint contrasts (adjacent minus alternating) have same nonzero sign and abs diff>=0.15 in BOTH densities, and all prebreak synchrony checks succeed, label sequence_sensitivity_signal_needs_new_seed_replication.
preregistered_decision.small: If all four primary contrasts across both densities are abs<=0.10 and prebreak sync holds, label no_large_sequence_effect_detected_descriptive.
preregistered_decision.underpowered: If insufficient selected or first-break pairs, label underpowered.
